beats.summary: The office watches news coverage of the Scranton Strangler standoff.

evidence.snippet: They caught the Scranton Stranger, they trapped him in his house.
Police have now surrounded the apartment complex.

beats.summary: Michael and others react excitedly to the news and the standoff location.

evidence.snippet: Michael (whispEring to Pam): They have him surrounded. It's the SWAT.
Michael: Ok, that's our street! That's our street! He's going down our street! Come on everybody!

beats.summary: Michael humorously pretends to be serious about not attending a party but then admits he is a fan of Glee and will attend.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I'm joking. I'm kidding around! I'm not actually angry.
Michael: You know who my favorite character is? The invalid. I am coming to your party.

beats.summary: Erin tries to convince Michael and Andy to come to a party at Gabe's apartment to watch Glee.

evidence.snippet: Erin: You and Michael are always the life of the party!
Andy: Try and keep me from coming!

beats.summary: Michael and Gabe prepare for the party with pizza making and Gabe showing his 'Man Cave'.

evidence.snippet: Michael (tossing pizza dough in the air):
Gabe (walking with Jim and Pam): Welcome to my Man Cave!

beats.summary: Pam explains Cece's reverse cycling sleep pattern causing her to be up all night.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Cece, is reverse cycling, which means she sleeps all day and is up all night.
